name: Shimai to Now.
source:
The protagonist has 2 sisters, who are working as a model and an idol. In order to help them lessen the burden of supporting the family, he takes care of the housework—e.g., cooking, laundry, cleaning... However, he is still a growing boy and so holds some desires for his alluring sisters. 

One time, while engrossed in masturbating using their swimsuit poster, he is discovered by his older sister. Unexpectedly, she only smiles and says that she will help him with it. And so, they cross the siblings line. Furthermore, even his younger sister, who notices something going on, starts to make advances to him.

[Translated from [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/60shimai/story.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
主角有两个姐妹，分别是模特和偶像。为了帮助她们减轻养家的负担，他包揽家务——做饭、洗衣、打扫卫生……然而，他还是个成长中的男孩，所以对他迷人的姐妹们抱有一些渴望。

有一次，当他全神贯注地用泳装海报自慰时，被姐姐发现了。没想到她只是笑笑说会帮他。就这样，他们跨越了兄弟姐妹的界限。而且，就连他的妹妹也察觉到了一些事情，也开始向他示好。

[翻译自[url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/60shimai/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
